text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's victory is hotly<n>anticipated as the
autumn Tenno Sho<n>is about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Intent on defeating her, Super Creek<n>finishes
practicing for her role as the<n>villain.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She heads over to the racecourse to<n>stir up the
crowd at the autumn Tenno<n>Sho.
